{{include reference="Mesures.Code.MesureMacros"/}}
{{velocity wiki="false"}} ## The measure list as a CSV file for Excel (UTF-8 with BOM, semicolons), with the filters of the Fiches mesures page: ## /bin/get/Mesures/Code/ListeExport?bureau=A&perimetre=Secteur. Only sheets the reader can view are listed. #mesureBureaux ($bureaux) #set ($bureau = "$!request.bureau") #if (!$bureaux.containsKey($bureau)) #set ($bureau = '') #end #set ($perimetre = "$!request.perimetre") #if (!$mesurePerimetres.containsKey($perimetre)) #set ($perimetre = '') #end ## A filter left empty matches every bureau or perimeter. #set ($space = 'Mesures') #set ($filename = 'mesures') #foreach ($value in [$bureau, $perimetre]) #if ($value == '') #set ($space = "${space}.%") #else #set ($space = "${space}.$value") #set ($filename = "${filename}-$value.toLowerCase()") #end #end #set ($mesureClass = $xwiki.getClass('Mesures.Code.MesureClass')) #set ($richText = ['raisonEtre', 'modalitesModification', 'documentationInterne', 'documentationExterne']) #set ($q = '"') #set ($eol = $escapetool.unurl('%0D%0A')) #set ($lines = []) ## Quotes every cell. Excel runs a cell starting with = + - @ as a formula, so such cells get a leading apostrophe. #macro (csvRow $cells) #set ($quoted = []) #foreach ($cell in $cells) #set ($cell = "$!cell") #if ($cell.matches('(?s)^[=+@\t\r-].*')) #set ($cell = "'$cell") #end #set ($cell = $cell.replace($q, "$q$q")) #set ($discard = $quoted.add("$q$cell$q")) #end #set ($discard = $lines.add($stringtool.join($quoted, ';'))) #end #set ($headers = ['Identifiant', 'Intitulé', 'Bureau', 'Intitulé du bureau', 'Périmètre']) #foreach ($field in ['cleSource', 'dateCreation', 'vecteurJuridique']) #set ($discard = $headers.add($mesureClass.get($field).prettyName)) #end #foreach ($field in $richText) #set ($discard = $headers.add($mesureClass.get($field).prettyName)) #end #set ($discard = $headers.addAll(['Provenances', 'Complète', 'Dernière modification', 'Modifiée par', 'Adresse'])) #csvRow ($headers) #foreach ($fullName in $services.query.xwql("from doc.object(Mesures.Code.MesureClass) as m where doc.space like :space order by doc.space, doc.name").bindValue('space', $space).execute()) ## Rights are checked here: the query's 'viewable' filter drops every result on XWiki 17.10. #set ($sheetRef = $services.model.resolveDocument($fullName)) #if ($services.security.authorization.hasAccess('view', $sheetRef)) #set ($sheetDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($sheetRef)) #set ($mesureObj = $sheetDoc.getObject('Mesures.Code.MesureClass')) #mesurePlace ($sheetDoc $place) #if ($mesureObj && $place.bureau) #set ($date = $mesureObj.getValue('dateCreation')) #set ($row = [$sheetDoc.documentReference.name, $sheetDoc.plainTitle, $place.bureau, "$!bureaux.get($place.bureau).name", $mesurePerimetres.get($place.perimetre), "$!mesureObj.getValue('cleSource')", "#if ($date)$xwiki.formatDate($date, 'dd/MM/yyyy')#end", "$!mesureObj.getValue('vecteurJuridique')"]) #foreach ($field in $richText) ## Parsed and rendered without running macros, so nothing runs with this page's rights (R22). #set ($text = "$!mesureObj.getValue($field)") #set ($xdom = $services.rendering.parse($text, 'xwiki/2.1')) #if ($xdom) #set ($text = $services.rendering.render($xdom, 'plain/1.0')) #end #set ($discard = $row.add($text)) #end #set ($provenances = []) #foreach ($provenance in $sheetDoc.getObjects('Mesures.Code.ProvenanceClass')) #set ($frequence = "$!provenance.getValue('frequence')") #set ($discard = $provenances.add("$!provenance.getValue('donnee') : $!provenance.getValue('emetteur')#if ($frequence != ''), $frequence#end")) #end #mesureComplete ($sheetDoc $complete) #set ($discard = $row.add($stringtool.join($provenances, $eol))) #set ($discard = $row.add("#if ($complete)oui#{else}non#end")) #set ($discard = $row.add($xwiki.formatDate($sheetDoc.date, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'))) #set ($discard = $row.add($xwiki.getPlainUserName($sheetDoc.authorReference))) #set ($discard = $row.add($sheetDoc.getExternalURL('view'))) #csvRow ($row) #end #end #end ## Written straight to the response, with a BOM so that Excel reads UTF-8: the rendering would reflow the lines. #set ($csv = "$escapetool.unurl('%EF%BB%BF')$stringtool.join($lines, $eol)$eol") #set ($discard = $response.setContentType('text/csv; charset=UTF-8')) #set ($discard = $response.setHeader('Content-Disposition', "attachment; filename=$q${filename}.csv$q")) #set ($discard = $response.outputStream.write($csv.getBytes('UTF-8'))) #set ($discard = $xcontext.setFinished(true)) {{/velocity}}
